description: This Java class defines a Fragment (LogFragment) that contains a custom LogView for displaying logs within an Android application. It manages the creation and configuration of views, handles text change events to scroll the view appropriately, and provides access to the LogView instance.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that hosts a LogView widget inside a ScrollView, used for displaying log data with auto-scrolling capabilities.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom view component used for displaying log messages. Details of implementation are not provided in this file.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Constructs and sets up the ScrollView and LogView, applies styling, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Android lifecycle method that inflates views, sets up event listeners, and returns the fragment's view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
